name: scrimba
description: Official Scrimba plugins for AI agents.

plugins.name: scrimba-explain
plugins.description: Explain by Scrimba — ask your agent to explain anything as an instant narrated slideshow: a concept, a document, an architecture, a codebase, a git branch or PR, or the changes it just made. Built live with animations, diagrams, maths, and code, at a scrimba.com link. Offers an explainer when the agent has changed a lot of code.
